summary: A web page from Elite Restoration, a restoration company in Idaho, explaining the three categories of water damage: clean water (Category 1), grey water (Category 2), and black water (Category 3). It describes sources, hazards, and when to call professionals, and the rest of the page is site navigation, customer reviews, insurance logos, and contact details.
one_line: Elite Restoration's guide to the three categories of water damage (clean, grey, black) and when to call professionals.
key_facts: Elite Restoration says flooding is the most common problem that people call the company in for.
Category 1 clean water damage is from a considerably sanitary or natural source and generally comes from a broken appliance, malfunctioning sprinkler, a burst pipe, melting snow, or rainwater.
Clean water left unattended for over 24 hours risks mold and mildew, so the page advises calling a local Elite Restoration office.
Category 2 grey water damage is somewhat unsanitary, coming from an unsanitary source or having been unmitigated for a long period of time.
Toilet water or washing machine water might be considered grey water, which can contain urine, laundry detergents, or blood.
The page advises wearing gloves while cleaning Category 2 water damage and keeping small children and pets away from it.
Category 3 black water damage is the most hazardous type and usually results from a natural disaster or raw sewage.
Black water is typically full of chemicals, pathogens, pesticides, or other harmful biological and/or chemical bacteria.
Flooding freshwater or ocean water is also considered black water, due to unknown contaminants.
The page advises that black water cleanup should not be handled by homeowners and that Elite Restoration has the proper equipment for it.
Elite Restoration states it has over 40 years of construction background.
Elite Restoration says its team is on stand-by 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year, with an hour or less response time.
Elite Restoration's listed contractor license is RCE 28623 and its IICRC Certification is 206704.
The company lists locations in Twin Falls, Boise, Meridian, Pocatello, Bellevue, and Burley, Idaho, and announced expansion into Idaho Falls.
